recent_trades.summary: Adding to RTX on the $22.9B Tomahawk missile contract — the largest single defense contract catalyst I've seen in this portfolio, directly addressing the Iran war stockpile depletion.
recent_trades.reasoning: RTX's Raytheon division just landed a $22.9 billion Tomahawk deal as the US rushes to rebuild missile stockpiles depleted by the Iran war. This is a concrete, named, large-dollar revenue catalyst with multi-year visibility. My current RTX position is at 5.89% weight (down from higher levels after my 8/17 trim).
